title: DrugAnalysis — FDA Decisions & Biotech Reactions
description: Biopharma decision engine tracking publicly traded companies against FDA drug decisions, verified stock-price reactions and clinical-pipeline success rates, rendered as a dependency-free static site with no build step. The project is now at v29 (2026-09-22) and the whole-table census has landed: the official Drugs@FDA Submissions.txt holds 193,810 rows, and the boundary the project defends holds over all of them — 0 rows are dated between the FD&C Act (1938-06-25) and 1938-12-31. That census also contradicted two of the project's own v28 working hypotheses and v29 publishes the contradictions verbatim rather than smoothing them: the before-1939 window holds 1 row rather than 0 (ApplNo 060904, ORIG 1, AP, dated 1900-01-01, a pre-statute placeholder published as FLAG-PRE-STATUTE-DATE with counted_as_fda_decision false), the undated window holds 8 rows (1 ORIG on 009658 plus 7 SUPPL) enumerated as FLAG-UNDATED-ROW, and the arithmetic 193,810 = 1 + 8 + 193,801 is stated in the artifact. The status census over the complete table is AP 192,604 / TA 1,205 / empty 1 — not the AP-only census v28 expected — with TA defined verbatim from FDA's own Drugs@FDA glossary as a tentative approval that does not allow marketing, so the project's wording was refined from 'approval actions only' to 'approval-family actions only (AP, TA)'; the type census is ORIG 27,862 / SUPPL 165,948 and the builder now aborts on any status outside {AP, TA, empty}. ApplNos 060904 and 009658 have no row in the official Applications table in either publication, appear in no committed window and in no project table, and render no application section on their official overview pages — no cause is inferred. Two corrections are recorded as corrections, not as footnotes: v28 wrote that NDA000159 was already counted in data/pre1965_fda_decisions.csv, which was false (that table holds NME-comparable rows only, earliest 1942, and NDA000159 is row PRE1965AUDIT-1939-02 of the pre-1965 originals audit table), and the same error class had already been caught for NDA000004 in v28. A runner defect that made Actions runs 32 and 33 fail was found and fixed: zip_extract re-downloaded the official ZIP on every run and overwrote the SHA-pinned window extracts, so every SHA-gated builder aborted and the workflow's if: always() commit step pushed the drifted payloads to the feature branch after the PR had merged; zip_extract now honours skip_existing and a run that produces only skipped-existing stubs leaves manifest.json byte-identical, and a failed page-0 fetch in the paged openFDA kinds no longer writes a 0-record payload with status 200 over the committed file. The layers the previous version of this entry described still stand and are re-quoted: 1,215 rows in the full 1938-1964 submission register (850 ORIG/AP originals plus 365 SUPPL/AP supplements, every one of them submission_status AP — 0 RE and 0 W rows, because the official Submissions.txt publishes approval actions only and refused/withdrawn decisions are simply not obtainable from that source for any year, so the project's non-approval evidence is FDA's separate 458-letter CRL database), and the v26 census of 535 original approvals for 1939-1964 cross-checked against the full official database map of 29,336 applications with 0 absent, 0 application-type mismatches and 0 holder mismatches. scripts/validate_data.py was executed here and reports PASS: schema, IDs, dates, ranges and source URL checks succeeded.

flags: Moving faster than this directory can snapshot: DrugAnalysis advanced v21.1 -> v26 -> v27 across three of this audit's own build passes, the last landing while the audit was running. Every count here is a point-in-time read at commit 0d2dbcd.

The repository publishes verified negatives as first-class results rather than omissions: 1938 gets a row in data/pre1938_determination.csv recording that 1,216 official submission rows were searched and 0 exist for that year, and FDA's own series publishes 1938-40 only combined.

Five pre-1965 irregularities remain flagged and deliberately uncorrected (NDA008592, NDA010028, NDA009149, NDA012265, NDA012486), where a later application appears to precede an earlier original — one of them identified as a source coverage gap rather than a data error.
